y-m-46-02.material: Epulanini lezixhumanisi kunamaphoyinti amabili A(0, 0), B(0, 8). Cabanga ngezindingilizi ezidlula kokubili A no-B. Inkaba yendingilizi ngu-(a, b) futhi i-radius ngu-r (r > 0). y-m-46-02.s.s1.prompt: Yenza izindingilizi ezintathu ezidlula kokubili A no-B, ngayinye inenkaba ehlukile. Faka inkaba (a, b) ne-radius r. Uma i-radius ingeyona i-rational, ungafaka ukulinganisela kwedesimali.

y-m-46-02.s.s1.hint.1: Misa i-x-coordinate a yenkaba ibe inani elilula elifana no-0 noma 3, bese uthola b no-r ezanelisa zombili izimo ku-A no-B. Uma r ingeyona i-rational, ungayilinganisela ngedesimali.

y-m-46-02.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke izimo lapho, uma kungezwa esisodwa ezindingilizini ezidlula ku-A no-B, kunqunywa indingilizi eyodwa ncamashi.

y-m-46-04.title: Amaphoyinti anamabanga asesilinganisweni se-1 : 2 alala emugqeni?
y-m-46-04.goal: Hlukanisa ukuthi ungaya kude kangakanani ngobufakazi bamaphoyinti ambalwa, thola amaphoyinti amaningi anelisa isimo ukulinganisela isimo se-locus, bese usho inqubo edingekayo ukuqinisekisa.
y-m-46-04.material:
Epulanini lezixhumanisi kunamaphoyinti amabili A(−2, 0), B(4, 0), futhi iphoyinti P lanelisa PB = 2 × PA. (PA yibanga elisuka ephoyintini P liye ku-A.) U민호 uthe: "Uma PA = PB, khona P ise-perpendicular bisector (umugqa) yengxenye AB. Lapho isilinganiso singu-1 : 2, lawo ma-P nawo azoba emugqeni owodwa." Ukuhlola isitatimende sika민호, kuphenywe amaphoyinti amane anelisa PB = 2 PA.
Iphoyinti | PA | PB | PB = 2PA
P1(0, 0) | 2 | 4 | liyanelisa
P2(−8, 0) | 6 | 12 | liyanelisa
P3(−4, 4) | √20 | √80 | liyanelisa
P4(−4, −4) | √20 | √80 | liyanelisa
(√20 ifundwa 'root twenty'.)

y-m-46-01.title: Ukubala kwebanga luka-서윤: kwaphosa kuphi?
y-m-46-01.goal: Thola futhi ulungise umugqa lapho isixazululo sebanga phakathi kwemigqa emibili ehambisanayo ebhalwe ngama-coefficient ahlukile siphosa khona, futhi wenze imigqa emibili efanelana nesimo.
y-m-46-01.material: 서윤 waxazulula kanje ukuthola ibanga phakathi kwemigqa emibili u-l: 2x + y − 3 = 0 no-m: 4x + 2y + 5 = 0. (U-2x + y − 3 = 0 ufundwa 'two x plus y minus three equals zero'. U-√5 ufundwa 'root five'.) Imigqa emibili iyahambisana. Esixazululweni esingezansi, umugqa ngamunye unenombolo.
y-m-46-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ukuthi kungani kufanele ufanise ama-coefficient ngaphambi kokuqhathanisa

U-H3 uyizinga lobunzima lokwabiwa kwalokhu kukhiqizwa futhi akusho ukuthi ikharikhulamu ibeka lokhu okuqukethwe ebangeni elithile.
y-m-46-01.prereq.1: Ifomu u-ax+by+c=0 lesibalo somugqa, nokwahlulela imigqa ehambisanayo ngokuthambeka
y-m-46-01.prereq.2: Indlela yokuthola ibanga phakathi kwephoyinti nomugqa (Common Mathematics yesikole esiphakeme, izibalo zemimumo)
y-m-46-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala esixazululweni luka-서윤 ophosile.
y-m-46-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ama-coefficient luka-x no-y wezibalo ezimbili eceleni komunye futhi uqhathanise ukuthi anefomu elifanayo yini.

y-m-46-01.s.s1.line.0: U-l: 2x + y − 3 = 0 no-m: 4x + 2y + 5 = 0 banesilinganiso esifanayo sama-coefficient luka-x no-y, 2 : 1 = 4 : 2, ngakho bayahambisana.
y-m-46-01.s.s1.line.1: Ibanga phakathi kwemigqa emibili ehambisanayo enama-coefficient afanayo u-ax + by + c₁ = 0, ax + by + c₂ = 0 ngu-|c₁ − c₂| ÷ √(a² + b²).
y-m-46-01.s.s1.line.2: Igama eliqhubekayo luka-l ngu--3 futhi elika-m ngu-5, ngakho umehluko wamagama aqhubekayo ngu-|5 − (−3)| = 8.
y-m-46-01.s.s1.line.3: Usebenzisa ama-coefficient luka-l, √(2² + 1²) = √5, ngakho ibanga ngu-8 ÷ √5 = 8√5/5.
y-m-46-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uyaphosa. Indlela esemgqeni 2 ingasetshenziswa kuphela uma ama-coefficient luka-x no-y ezibalweni ezimbili efana ngqo, kodwa u-l unou-2x + y futhi u-m unou-4x + 2y, ngakho ama-coefficient ahlukile. Nokho emgqeni 3 amagama aqhubekayo u--3 no-5 akhishwa njengoba enjalo, ngaphandle kokufanisa ama-coefficient. Umugqa 4 wathola leli nani. Uma uhlukanisa u-m ngo-2 ukuyifanisa njengo-2x + y + 5/2 = 0, umehluko wamagama aqhubekayo ngu-|5/2 − (−3)| = 11/2 futhi ibanga ngu-(11/2) ÷ √5 = 11√5/10.
y-m-46-01.s.s2.prompt: Uma isixazululo luka-서윤 silungisiwe, yiliphi ibanga elilungile phakathi kwemigqa emibili u-l no-m?
y-m-46-01.s.s2.hint.0: Thola iphoyinti ku-l elula ukubala ngalo (isibonelo, uma u-x = 0).
y-m-46-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ibanga kusuka kuleli phoyinti kuya ku-m futhi uliqhathanise namanani asezinketho.
y-m-46-01.s.s2.r.a: Leli yinani lika-서윤 njengoba linjalo. Lilinani elasebenzisa umehluko wamagama aqhubekayo ama-coefficient ehlukile.
y-m-46-01.s.s2.r.b: Lisebenzise u-8 njengomehluko wamagama aqhubekayo, ngaphandle kokufanisa ama-coefficient, futhi lashintsha okuhlukanisayo kwaba ngama-coefficient luka-m. Izindinganiso ezindaweni ezimbili ziyahluka.
y-m-46-01.s.s2.r.c: Ifanisile umehluko wezinkathi ezingaguquki, 11, kodwa isebenzise ama-coefficient ka-l (√5) esihlukanisini. Umehluko wezinkathi ezingaguquki zendlela 4x + 2y no-√(4² + 2²) kumele uthathwe kusibalo esifanayo.
y-m-46-01.s.s2.r.d: Ngemva kokufanisa ama-coefficient emigqa emibili ukuze afane, kuthathe umehluko wezinkathi ezingaguquki nesihlukanisi kusibalo esifanayo.
y-m-46-01.s.s2.explain: Ukukala ngqo ibanga elisuka ephoyintini (0, 3) ku-l kuya ku-m nakho kunikeza |0 + 6 + 5| ÷ √(16 + 4) = 11/(2√5) = 11√5/10. Indlela yokufanisa ama-coefficient nendlela yokukala kusukela ephoyintini elilodwa kunikeza inani elifanayo.
y-m-46-01.s.s3.prompt: Yenza imigqa emibili 2x + y + k = 0 ehambisana ne-l futhi isebangeni elingu-√5 ncamashi kusuka ku-l, ngamanani amabili ahlukene ka-k.

y-m-46-10.title: Izinhlobo ezimbili zokuhamba: umphumela uyafana uma ushintshanisa ukulandelana?
y-m-46-10.goal: Hlola ngamacala amaningana ukuthi ukulandelana kuthinta kanjani umphumela lapho kwenziwa ukuhambisa nokubukisa emgqeni u-y = x ngokulandelana, thola isimo lapho umphumela ufana noma ukulandelana kushintshiwe, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani.
y-m-46-10.material: Indilinga u-C: (x − 1)² + (y − 2)² = 4 inesikhungo u-(1, 2) nomsebe ongu-2. Cabanga ngokuhamba okubili. U-T(a, b): hambisa wonke amaphoyinti ngo-a ohlangothini luka-x futhi ngo-b ohlangothini luka-y. U-S: bukisa emgqeni u-y = x. (Iphoyinti u-(p, q) lihanjiswa liye ku-(q, p).) "U-T bese u-S" kusho ukwenza u-T kuqala bese u-S emphumeleni, futhi "u-S bese u-T" kusho ukwenza u-S kuqala bese u-T emphumeleni. Indilinga igcina umsebe wayo uma ihanjiswa, ngakho udinga ukulandela kuphela indawo yesikhungo. (U-(x − 1)² ufundwa "x minus 1, squared," futhi u-y = x ufundwa "y equals x.")
y-m-46-10.prereq.1: Ukuhambisa u-(x, y) → (x + a, y + b)
y-m-46-10.prereq.2: Ukubukisa ngaphesheya kwe-x-axis u-(x, y) → (x, −y) nesibalo sendilinga
y-m-46-10.s.s1.prompt: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho icala livezwa, khetha isahlulelo mayelana nokuthi imiphumela yokulandelana okubili ('T bese u-S', 'S bese u-T') iyafana yini.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.hint.0: Landela isikhungo esisodwa u-(1, 2) kuphela futhi ubhale ukuxhumanisa esinyathelweni ngasinye.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ethebuleni, qoqa imigqa efanayo nemigqa ehlukile, futhi ufune lokho ezifana ngakho.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Sizamile u-T(3, 3). "T bese u-S": isikhungo u-(1, 2) → (4, 5) → (5, 4). "S bese u-T": isikhungo u-(1, 2) → (2, 1) → (5, 4). Imiphumela yokulandelana okubili yayifana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ubona leli cala, ucabangani manje mayelana nokuthi imiphumela yokulandelana okubili iyafana yini?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ku-T(3, 3), imiphumela yokulandelana okubili yayifana. Kodwa likhona icala elilodwa kuphela, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi lokhu kuyiqiniso nakwa-T abanye.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Uma ukulandelana kushintshwa, umphumela uhlala uhlukile.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ecaleni osanda kulibona, babefana. Lesi simangalo asihambisani necala.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Noma yimuphi u-T, imiphumela yokulandelana okubili ihlala ifana.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Likhona icala elilodwa kuphela. Awukwazi ukuphetha u-"njalo" kusuka ecaleni elilodwa. Udinga ukuhlola nakwa-T abanye.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Iyindilinga, ngakho iyafana noma ukulandelana kuyini.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kufanele ulandele lapho isikhungo siya khona, hhayi umumo wendilinga.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Bafana kuleli cala. Sidinga ukuhlola kakhulu ukuthi bafana yini nakwa-T abanye.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lona umkhuba wokucabanga ukuthi into eyafana ecaleni elilodwa ingaqhutshekiswa ecaleni elijwayelekile.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Sizamile u-T(3, 0). "T bese u-S": isikhungo u-(1, 2) → (4, 2) → (2, 4). "S bese u-T": isikhungo u-(1, 2) → (2, 1) → (5, 1). Imiphumela emibili yayihlukile.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ubona leli cala, uzokwenzani ngomcabango wakho wokuqala?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Isikhungo se-"T bese u-S" singu-(2, 4) futhi isikhungo se-"S bese u-T" singu-(5, 1), ngakho ziyizindilinga ezihlukile. Kuvele isibonelo esiphikisayo, ngakho isitatimende esithi "zihlala zifana" asisebenzi.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Leli cala likhethekile, ngakho ngigcina umcabango wami wokuqala njengoba unjalo.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Umcabango othi 'uhlala ufana' uphulwa yisibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo. Hlola futhi ukubala kwaleli cala.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lahla umcabango othi 'uhlala ufana' futhi ubone ukuthi uhluka kuye ngo-T.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulahle u-'njalo' ngenxa yesibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo futhi wahlela ukuthi kuhluka kuye ngezimo.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ukubala kumele kube kuphosile. Kufanele kunike umphumela ofanayo.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Izikhungo ezimbili ziphuma zihlukile, u-(2, 4) no-(5, 1). Phinda wenze ukubala okubili wena.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Usayizi wendilinga uyashintsha esikhundleni sendawo yesikhungo, ngakho abakwazi ukuqhathaniswa.

y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yisiphi isimo esifanele ku-(a, b) ukuze imiphumela yokulandelana okubili ifane?
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Ku-"T bese u-S" isikhungo singu-(2 + b, 1 + a), futhi ku-"S bese u-T" singu-(2 + a, 1 + b), ngakho bayafana kuphela uma u-2 + b = 2 + a, okungukuthi, uma u-a = b. Njengoba u-S ushintshanisa i-x-coordinate ne-y-coordinate, uma u-T enziwa kuqala, amanani okuhambisa u-a no-b nawo ayashintshaniswa.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kuphela uma u-a = 0 (u-b angaba yinoma yiliphi inani)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ku-(3, 3) no-(−2, −2), u-a akasiwo u-0 kodwa imiphumela yayifana. Bheka ukuthi yiliphi inani imigqa efanayo ethebuleni efana ngalo.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kuphela uma u-a = −b (uma u-a no-b benezimpawu eziphambene)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Emigqeni efanayo yethebula, izimpawu zika-a no-b ziyafana. Funa lokho imigqa efanayo ezifana ngakho.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kuphela uma u-a = b (uma amabanga amabili okuhamba elingana)
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Imigqa eyayifana inou-a = b, futhi imigqa eyayihlukile inou-a ≠ b. Uma ulandela ukuxhumanisa kwesikhungo, kuyisimo sokuthi u-2 + b no-2 + a balingane, futhi u-1 + a no-1 + b balingane.
y-m-46-10.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ahlala ehlukile, noma u-(a, b) eyini
y-m-46-10.s.s1.reflect: Ecaleni lokuqala u-(3, 3), impendulo kwakungu-"bafana," futhi ngemuva kwalokho ecaleni lesibili kwaphuma u-"bahlukile". Buyekeza ukuthi yini eyayiyingozi ekujikelezisweni kusuka ecaleni elilodwa lapho babefana, nokuthi yini imigqa efanayo nemigqa ehlukile yethebula efana ngayo.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani imiphumela yokulandelana okubili ihluka uma u-a ≠ b, ngokuchaza ukuthi ukuxhumanisa kwesikhungo u-(1, 2) kuhamba kanjani.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kokulandelana ngakunye, bhala i-x-coordinate ne-y-coordinate yesikhungo, umugqa owodwa ngamunye.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa, ngokulandelana, ukuthi ukubukisa u-S kuthinta kanjani amanani okuhambisa u-a no-b.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ubhale uhlukanisa ukuthi izindima zamanani okuhambisa u-a no-b ziyashintshaniswa noma azishintshaniswa lapho ludlula ekubukiseni?
y-m-46-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ucabange nangokuthi kungani akukho mehluko uma u-a = b?
y-m-46-10.s.s2.model.0: Uma u-T enziwa kuqala, isikhungo siba ngu-(1 + a, 2 + b), futhi njengoba u-S ushintshanisa i-x-coordinate ne-y-coordinate, siba ngu-(2 + b, 1 + a). Uma u-S enziwa kuqala, siba ngu-(2, 1), bese ngo-T siba ngu-(2 + a, 1 + b). Ngakho uma u-a ≠ b, ama-x-coordinate u-2 + b no-2 + a ahlukile, ngakho imiphumela ihlukile.
y-m-46-10.s.s2.model.1: U-S ushintshanisa i-x-coordinate ne-y-coordinate, ngakho uma ukuhambisa kwenziwa kuqala, amanani okuhambisa u-a no-b nawo ayashintshaniswa, futhi kufana sengathi isikhungo sihambe ngokuvundlile ngo-b nangokuqondile ngo-a. Uma u-S enziwa kuqala, sihamba ngokuvundlile ngo-a nangokuqondile ngo-b. Ngakho uma u-a no-b behlukile, umphumela uncike ekulandelaneni.
